dialogues.jp: 月城のヤツ、今日もいるだろうか。
dialogues.en: Wonder whether that Tsukishiro's there today...
dialogues.text: Wonder whether that Tsukishiro's there today...

dialogues.jp: なんとなく気になる。
dialogues.en: I couldn't keep that out of my mind.
dialogues.text: I couldn't keep that out of my mind.

dialogues.jp:
特に、俺に関係ある訳じゃないけれど、どこと
なく気になってしまう。そんな雰囲気を持って
いる。
dialogues.en:
In all honesty, it had nothing to do with me. Yet, that
nagging feeling wouldn't go away.
dialogues.text:
In all honesty, it had nothing to do with me. Yet, that
nagging feeling wouldn't go away.

dialogues.jp:
会って、何を話す訳でもなく、ただ月城のして
いることを見てるだけ。
dialogues.en:
I didn't have anything in particular to tell her either; I
just wanted to see her.
dialogues.text:
I didn't have anything in particular to tell her either; I
just wanted to see her.

dialogues.jp:
場合によっては、あの人形と話をする。あまり
まともな話をする人形ではないが、ほとんど話
をしない月城より随分マシだ。
dialogues.en:
Although when I do, I'd end up talking to a doll. Though
It's almost preferable to talking to the straight-lipped
Tsukishiro.
dialogues.text:
Although when I do, I'd end up talking to a doll. Though
It's almost preferable to talking to the straight-lipped
Tsukishiro.

dialogues.jp:
月城ともちゃんと話をしてみたいが、なかなか
彼女は自分の口を開いてくれない。
dialogues.en:
I'd much rather talk to Tsukishiro, of course. But when she
won't open her mouth, that's not the easiest thing to do.
dialogues.text:
I'd much rather talk to Tsukishiro, of course. But when she
won't open her mouth, that's not the easiest thing to do.

dialogues.jp:
恥ずかしいのか、話すのが苦手なのか、それと
もうまく喋れないだけなのか、わからないけれ
ど、あまり口を開くことはない。
dialogues.en:
Whether she's embarassed to talk, bad at it, refraining from
it for health matters, whatever the case, she never opens
her mouth.
dialogues.text:
Whether she's embarassed to talk, bad at it, refraining from
it for health matters, whatever the case, she never opens
her mouth.

dialogues.jp:
あの人形が本当に喋っているのではなく、あく
まで月城の腹話術だというのなら、本人が喋れ
ない訳ではないと思うんだが……。
dialogues.en:
Even if she's making that doll talk through ventriloquism,
it means nothing if the person herself isn't speaking...
dialogues.text:
Even if she's making that doll talk through ventriloquism,
it means nothing if the person herself isn't speaking...

dialogues.jp: 「月城ー、いるか？」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro, you there?"
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro, you there?"

dialogues.jp:
返事がない。けど、もともと返事をしないヤツ
なのだから、いるかどうかわからない。
dialogues.en:
No response. That didn't really answer my question though,
as that girl wouldn't answer even if she was there.
dialogues.text:
No response. That didn't really answer my question though,
as that girl wouldn't answer even if she was there.

dialogues.jp:
と言いつつ、この狭い体育館裏を見渡せば、い
るかいないかはすぐわかる。
dialogues.en:
Then again, given how narrow this gym rear is, a simple
look-over showed me the answer well enough.
dialogues.text:
Then again, given how narrow this gym rear is, a simple
look-over showed me the answer well enough.

dialogues.jp: ──ハイ、いませんね。
dialogues.en: ---Yup, not around.
dialogues.text: ---Yup, not around.

dialogues.jp:
何を期待していたのか、そう自分に問いたくな
るが、いないのならここには用はない。
dialogues.en:
Whatever expectations I was having, if she's not here,
there's no reason for me to be either.
dialogues.text:
Whatever expectations I was having, if she's not here,
there's no reason for me to be either.

dialogues.jp: くるりと｛きびす／踵｝を返す。
dialogues.en: I turned on my heels, ready to head back.
dialogues.text: I turned on my heels, ready to head back.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あれれぇ？　朝倉先輩じゃないですかぁ」
dialogues.en: "Huhhh? It's Asakura-senpai!"
dialogues.text: "Huhhh? It's Asakura-senpai!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「み、美春どうしたんだ、こんなところへ」
dialogues.en: "M, Miharu, what're you doing here?"
dialogues.text: "M, Miharu, what're you doing here?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春は……月城さんのことが気になって。こ
　の辺りによくいると聞いたもので」
dialogues.en:
"I was... kinda worried about Tsukishiro-san. I heard she
was around here lots, so..."
dialogues.text:
"I was... kinda worried about Tsukishiro-san. I heard she
was around here lots, so..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そうなのか」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.jp:
そういえば、美春は月城と友達になりたいなん
て言ってたな。
dialogues.en:
That's right, Miharu had said she wanted to try and be
Tsukishiro's friend.
dialogues.text:
That's right, Miharu had said she wanted to try and be
Tsukishiro's friend.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「先輩こそ、こんなところでなにしてるんです
　か？」
dialogues.en: "What about you, senpai?"
dialogues.text: "What about you, senpai?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「いや、俺は別に……」
dialogues.en: "Er, nothing, I'm just..."
dialogues.text: "Er, nothing, I'm just..."

dialogues.jp:
美春と同じように、月城の様子を見に来た……
とは、あまり言いたいものじゃあないな。
dialogues.en:
The same as her, more or less.. but it was harder for me to
say.
dialogues.text:
The same as her, more or less.. but it was harder for me to
say.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「誰かに呼び出されたんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Who were you meeting here?"
dialogues.text: "Who were you meeting here?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「誰が、こんなところに人を呼び出すんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Why would anyone want to meet in this place?"
dialogues.text: "Why would anyone want to meet in this place?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「えー、呼びますよぅ」
dialogues.en: "Ehhh, there could be reasons!"
dialogues.text: "Ehhh, there could be reasons!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「たとえば……」
dialogues.en: "Like..."
dialogues.text: "Like..."

dialogues.jp:
美春がコホンと軽く咳払いをし、姿勢をあらた
める。
dialogues.en:
Miharu coughed a few times to clear her throat, then
straightened up.
dialogues.text:
Miharu coughed a few times to clear her throat, then
straightened up.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「こんなところに俺を呼んで、どうしようって
　んだ？」
dialogues.en: "Why the hell did you call me out here?"
dialogues.text: "Why the hell did you call me out here?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「てめぇ……最近、調子に乗りすぎじゃねェの
　か？」
dialogues.en: "You... you've been getting too confident lately."
dialogues.text: "You... you've been getting too confident lately."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「｛ウチ／学園｝は誰が仕切ってるか、知ってんだろ？」
dialogues.en: "Don't you know who I am in this school?"
dialogues.text: "Don't you know who I am in this school?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「転校生はおとなしくパシッてりゃいいんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"Transfer student or not, I'm going to teach you a lesson
you won't forget."
dialogues.text:
"Transfer student or not, I'm going to teach you a lesson
you won't forget."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「は。だからこんなところにわざわざ呼び出し
　たってのか？　えらく古いセンスの持ち主だ
　な」
dialogues.en:
"Hm. So that's why you called me out here? Old-fashioned,
aren't you."
dialogues.text:
"Hm. So that's why you called me out here? Old-fashioned,
aren't you."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「うるせぇ！　てめぇのそういうところがウザッ
　テェってんだよ！　この状況を見て、まだ言
　うってのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Shut the hell up! You've really got guts to mouth off right
now!"
dialogues.text:
"Shut the hell up! You've really got guts to mouth off right
now!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「３人いれば、勝てるとでも思ったのか？」
dialogues.en: "You think you can win against 3 people?"
dialogues.text: "You think you can win against 3 people?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……それ、いつまで続くんだ？」
dialogues.en: "...How long are you going to continue that?"
dialogues.text: "...How long are you going to continue that?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「え……、あ、その……ご希望でしたら激闘編
　と抗争編まで」
dialogues.en: "Uh... ah, such as... an arranged brawl."
dialogues.text: "Uh... ah, such as... an arranged brawl."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「いいよ……よくわかったから」
dialogues.en: "...You sure seem to know a lot about that."
dialogues.text: "...You sure seem to know a lot about that."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、後、体育館裏って言ったら……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, and since you were talking about the gym rear..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, and since you were talking about the gym rear..."

dialogues.jp: ……もう一本あるのかよ。
dialogues.en: ...And thusly, another story unfolded.
dialogues.text: ...And thusly, another story unfolded.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「どうしたんだ、鈴木。こんなところに俺を呼
　んで」
dialogues.en:
"Is something wrong, Suzuki? To call me out here like
this..."
dialogues.text:
"Is something wrong, Suzuki? To call me out here like
this..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「先輩、あの……その……実は、私……先輩の
　ことが……」
dialogues.en: "Senpai... um, the truth is... I like..."
dialogues.text: "Senpai... um, the truth is... I like..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「鈴木……もしかして」
dialogues.en: "Suzuki... you mean..."
dialogues.text: "Suzuki... you mean..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「はい、あの、その……これ、私の気持ちです。
　読んでください！」
dialogues.en:
"Y, yes... ahh... all my feelings are written here... please
read it!"
dialogues.text:
"Y, yes... ahh... all my feelings are written here... please
read it!"

dialogues.jp:
美春が、そう言って、両手添えでバナナを差し
出す。
dialogues.en:
So saying, Miharu stretched our both her hands, to reveal...
a banana.
dialogues.text:
So saying, Miharu stretched our both her hands, to reveal...
a banana.

dialogues.jp: 「読めって言われてもな」
dialogues.en: "Since you requested so passionately..."
dialogues.text: "Since you requested so passionately..."

dialogues.jp: 俺はそのバナナを受け取り、皮をむく。
dialogues.en: I took the banana from her, and began to peel it.
dialogues.text: I took the banana from her, and began to peel it.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「って、ああ！　美春の秘蔵っ子が！」
dialogues.en: "A, ahhhh! My precioussss!"
dialogues.text: "A, ahhhh! My precioussss!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「だって、お前が……もぐもぐ、くれたんじゃ
　ないか」
dialogues.en: "Didn't you... gulp... just give this to me?"
dialogues.text: "Didn't you... gulp... just give this to me?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春は、先輩のために体育館裏の説明をした
　だけなのにぃ」
dialogues.en:
"I was explaining all the implications that come with the
rear of the gym to you!"
dialogues.text:
"I was explaining all the implications that come with the
rear of the gym to you!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あんな大げさな説明はいらん」
dialogues.en: "Too long; didn't listen."
dialogues.text: "Too long; didn't listen."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「どうせするなら、面白い方がいいじゃないで
　すかぁ」
dialogues.en: "But it is an interesting subject, isn't it?"
dialogues.text: "But it is an interesting subject, isn't it?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「内容よりも、お前を見てる方が面白かったく
　らいだ」
dialogues.en: "Watching you was far more entertaining."
dialogues.text: "Watching you was far more entertaining."

dialogues.jp:
食べ終わったバナナの皮をピッと茂みに向かっ
て投げ捨てる。
dialogues.en:
Finishing the banana, I carelessly threw the skin into a
nearby thicket.
dialogues.text:
Finishing the banana, I carelessly threw the skin into a
nearby thicket.

dialogues.jp: が、コントロールが外れて、地面に落ちる。
dialogues.en:
But my control was off, and it flitted to the ground
instead.
dialogues.text:
But my control was off, and it flitted to the ground
instead.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、月城さん……！」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Tsukishiro-san...!"
dialogues.text: "Ah, Tsukishiro-san...!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「な、なに？」
dialogues.en: "H, huh!?"
dialogues.text: "H, huh!?"

dialogues.jp:
今になってやってきた月城の目の前にバナナの
皮が落ち、月城がそれを踏まんばかりに足をあ
げていた。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro finally had appeared behind me, and was about to
step on the skin I had just thrown.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro finally had appeared behind me, and was about to
step on the skin I had just thrown.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「わわっ」
dialogues.en: "Wahwah!"
dialogues.text: "Wahwah!"

dialogues.jp: すべてがスローモーションに見える。
dialogues.en: Everything became exhibited in bullet time.
dialogues.text: Everything became exhibited in bullet time.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、水の中を歩いているかのように重い空気
の中に手を伸ばす。
dialogues.en:
Feeling as if I was underwater, I moved my arm against the
heavy pressure towards her.
dialogues.text:
Feeling as if I was underwater, I moved my arm against the
heavy pressure towards her.

dialogues.jp: どう考えても間に合わない。
dialogues.en: I'm not going to make it...
dialogues.text: I'm not going to make it...

dialogues.jp: 「つ〜き〜し〜ろ〜」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro!!"
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro!!"

dialogues.jp: ──ぎゅむ
dialogues.en: -*gyumu*
dialogues.text: -*gyumu*

dialogues.jp:
その瞬間、月城はバナナの皮を踏み、足を滑ら
せはしたが、その後まるで体操選手かのごとく
身体をひねり、体勢を立て直す。
dialogues.en:
In a split second, Tsukishiro stepped on the banana skin,
and lost her balance, but quickly recovered with the form of
a gymnast, and regained her posture.
dialogues.text:
In a split second, Tsukishiro stepped on the banana skin,
and lost her balance, but quickly recovered with the form of
a gymnast, and regained her posture.

dialogues.jp:
そして、何事もなかったかのように、また歩き
始める。
dialogues.en:
Then, she continued on her merry way, as if nothing had
happened.
dialogues.text:
Then, she continued on her merry way, as if nothing had
happened.

dialogues.jp: 「つ、月城、大丈夫だったか？」
dialogues.en: "T, Tsukishiro, are you alright!?"
dialogues.text: "T, Tsukishiro, are you alright!?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Senpai."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「月城さん、今……」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro-san, just now..."
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro-san, just now..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……天枷さん」
dialogues.en: "...Amakase-san?"
dialogues.text: "...Amakase-san?"

dialogues.jp:
月城がきょとんとした表情で、俺と美春の顔を
交互に見る。
dialogues.en:
With a slightly puzzled face, Alice alternated between
staring at Miharu and my own faces.
dialogues.text:
With a slightly puzzled face, Alice alternated between
staring at Miharu and my own faces.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……大丈夫」
dialogues.en: "...I'm fine."
dialogues.text: "...I'm fine."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、そう言うとそのまま、例の草のところ
に行きしゃがみ込む。
dialogues.en: She then took her usual stance, in front of the plant.
dialogues.text: She then took her usual stance, in front of the plant.

dialogues.jp: 「しかし、月城、運動神経いいんだな」
dialogues.en: "...Tsukishiro, your reflexes are amazing."
dialogues.text: "...Tsukishiro, your reflexes are amazing."

dialogues.jp:
あの動きは、偶然やまぐれではできない。もと
もと持ち合わせている本人の運動性能がなけれ
ばできるものではない。
dialogues.en:
That kind of movement wasn't just a fluke. She had to have
real ability to pull that off.
dialogues.text:
That kind of movement wasn't just a fluke. She had to have
real ability to pull that off.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春もびっくりしちゃいました。なんだかカッ
　コよかったですよ」
dialogues.en: "You scared me for a minute! That was really cool!"
dialogues.text: "You scared me for a minute! That was really cool!"

dialogues.jp:
草の方ばかり見ていた月城が俺達の方を見て、
ほんのりと頬を赤らめ、視線をずらす。
dialogues.en:
She stared at us after our compliments, then turned her face
away, blushing noticably.
dialogues.text:
She stared at us after our compliments, then turned her face
away, blushing noticably.

dialogues.jp:
そして、すっと立ちあがると、そのまま何も言
わずにてててっとどこかへ走っていった。
dialogues.en:
Suddenly, with nary a whisper, she got to her feet and
dashed off.
dialogues.text:
Suddenly, with nary a whisper, she got to her feet and
dashed off.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あらら」
dialogues.en: "Uh oh."
dialogues.text: "Uh oh."

dialogues.jp:
俺と美春は、顔を見合わせ、やれやれ……とい
うポーズをして見せる。
dialogues.en:
Miharu and I trned to face each other, and fell into
similar, disappointed poses.
dialogues.text:
Miharu and I trned to face each other, and fell into
similar, disappointed poses.

dialogues.jp: 月城と仲良くなるのは、なかなか難しいようだ。
dialogues.en: Getting close to Tsukishiro is going to be really difficult.
dialogues.text: Getting close to Tsukishiro is going to be really difficult.

dialogues.jp: ◆美春のバナナコント◆
dialogues.en: ◆Miharu's Tale of Bananas◆
dialogues.text: ◆Miharu's Tale of Bananas◆

dialogues.jp: 月城のことが気になり、体育館裏を訪れる。
dialogues.en:
Still thinking about Tsukishiro, I went to the back of the
gym.
dialogues.text:
Still thinking about Tsukishiro, I went to the back of the
gym.

dialogues.jp: だが、月城はおらず、代わりに美春がいた。
dialogues.en: But instead of Tsukishiro, I found Miharu there.
dialogues.text: But instead of Tsukishiro, I found Miharu there.

dialogues.jp:
美春も月城のことが気になっており、様子を見
に来たのだという。
dialogues.en:
Miharu said she was thinknig about Tsukishiro, and came here
to see her.
dialogues.text:
Miharu said she was thinknig about Tsukishiro, and came here
to see her.

dialogues.jp:
しばらくすると、月城がやってきたが、結局、
ほとんど会話をすることができず、逃げられて
しまった。
dialogues.en:
Alice popped up shortly after, but as we tried to talk to
her, she quickly ran off.
dialogues.text:
Alice popped up shortly after, but as we tried to talk to
her, she quickly ran off.

dialogues.jp: 月城と仲良くなるのは、なかなか難しいようだ。
dialogues.en: Getting close to Tsukishiro is going to be really difficult.
dialogues.text: Getting close to Tsukishiro is going to be really difficult.
